name: inspect_environment_template
description: Return capabilities and constraints of one approved environment template.

name: search_environment_modules
description: Search approved environment modules by world profile and class; never searches arbitrary paths or URLs.

name: build_environment_scene
description: Create a quarantined Blender environment package. The tool loader MUST resolve and inline the canonical schema and reject a hash mismatch.

name: get_environment_job_status
description: Return server-owned lifecycle status for one environment job.

name: validate_environment_package
description: Validate a quarantined package; never promotes it to the approved catalog.

name: render_environment_preview
description: Render allowlisted views of an existing quarantined environment job.
